description: Build conflict resolution UI in Git Control Tower. Extend DiffViewer with three-way merge view (ours/theirs/result panes) using Monaco editor. Each conflict region gets accept-ours, accept-theirs, and manual-edit actions. After all conflicts resolved, transition to merge commit composition. Reuse existing DiffViewer components and patterns. Support both keyboard and mouse workflows.
name: gct-conflict-resolution-ui
title: Three-way merge editor in DiffViewer with per-conflict actions
